errors.text_span: Първата диаграма, озаглавена „Number of Enterprises", показва, че секторът на другите услуги заема най-голям дял от 61% (19,0 млн.)
errors.evidence: The machine description incorrectly states that 'other services' occupy the largest share (61%) in the 'Number of Enterprises' chart, but the figure shows 'industry' as the largest share with 61% (19.0 million).

errors.text_span: Втората диаграма, „Number of Persons Employed", представя други услуги с 51% (80,2 млн.)
errors.evidence: The machine description incorrectly states that 'other services' occupy 51% (80.2 million) in the 'Number of Persons Employed' chart, but the figure shows 'industry' as the largest share with 51% (80.2 million).

errors.text_span: Третата диаграма, „Turnover", показва индустрия с 33% (10,6 трлн.)
errors.evidence: The machine description incorrectly states that 'industry' occupies 33% (10.6 trillion) in the 'Turnover' chart, but the figure shows 'other services' as the largest share with 33% (10.6 trillion).

errors.text_span: търговия с 31% (9,9 трлн.), други услуги с 31% (9,8 трлн.)
errors.evidence: The machine description swaps the values for 'trade' and 'other services' in the 'Turnover' chart. The figure shows 'trade' with 31% (9.8 trillion) and 'other services' with 31% (9.9 trillion).
The machine description incorrectly identifies the color for 'other services' as dark blue, but the figure shows it as brown.
The machine description does not mention that the sectors are not visually ordered by size in the pie charts, which is explicitly noted in the reference.
